paragraphs.chinese:
这一集讲的是，人们因为觉得隐瞒真相会让生活更轻松，于是选择说谎。和往常一样，这些谎言最后只制造了更大的麻烦。

菲尔在 Facebook 上重新联系上了高中时代的前女友丹妮丝。他本来准备和她出去喝一杯，克莱尔立刻起了疑心。菲尔坚持说两个人只是朋友，还干脆把丹妮丝邀请到家里，希望证明克莱尔反应过度。

一开始，丹妮丝表现得很友好，克莱尔也开始觉得自己也许想错了。可克莱尔刚一离开房间，丹妮丝就开始碰菲尔、对他调情，甚至还把自己酒店房间的钥匙交给了他。菲尔这才意识到，克莱尔对这件事的判断比自己准确得多。

事情很快变得更加尴尬。克莱尔找到一张旧照片，发现菲尔当年和她开始约会时，其实还没有正式和丹妮丝分手。丹妮丝非常生气，因为她一直以为菲尔早在认识克莱尔之前就已经离开了自己。她气冲冲地走了，留下菲尔同时得罪了两个女人。

与此同时，曼尼因为没能在学校的话剧里得到角色而很失落。杰给他买了一张励志海报，挂在他的宠物乌龟水箱上方。结果海报掉了下来，把乌龟压死了。

杰不想让曼尼怪自己，于是编出了一整套浣熊闯进家里的故事。他甚至故意弄乱房间，还留下泥脚印，好让整件事看起来更真实。格洛丽亚一眼就看穿了谎言，让他赶快坦白。

杰解释说，很多年前，他曾经不小心害死米切尔的一只宠物，并把真相告诉了他。米切尔一直记到现在，所以杰觉得，这一次撒谎也许反而更温柔。

乌龟葬礼上，曼尼发现自己之前在房间里留下了一袋打开的薯片。他开始责怪自己，觉得一定是食物把浣熊引了进来。杰心里很难受，却还是没有说出真正发生的事。

当天晚上，杰睡不着觉。他走进曼尼的房间时，发现曼尼还醒着，一直在等他。曼尼直接问他，那只乌龟真的是被浣熊害死的吗。杰这才承认，Shel其实是自己不小心害死的。他解释说，两个人的关系最近才刚刚变好，他撒谎是因为害怕曼尼会生自己的气。

米切尔也正在经历一场挣扎，因为工作总是让他错过和卡梅隆、莉莉在一起的时间。他已经错过了好几个重要时刻。当老板在一个家庭活动日又把他叫去工作时，米切尔终于拒绝了。

老板告诉他，如果现在离开，他就被开除了。米切尔走出办公室时觉得既骄傲又自由。可一回到家，他便开始担心钱的问题，也为自己的决定慌了起来。卡梅隆支持他，杰也答应在他找新工作期间帮忙，虽然所谓的“帮助”最后只是同一张励志海报。

到了最后，说出真相确实会让人不舒服，但这一集里的每一个谎言，都只让事情变得更加困难。
paragraphs.english:
This episode is about people hiding the truth because they think it will make life easier. As usual, the lies only create bigger problems.

Phil has reconnected with his old high school girlfriend, Denise, on Facebook. He plans to meet her for a drink, but Claire immediately becomes suspicious. Phil insists that they’re only friends and invites Denise to the house instead, hoping to prove that Claire is overreacting.

At first, Denise seems friendly, and Claire starts to think she was wrong. But as soon as Claire leaves the room, Denise begins touching Phil, flirting with him, and even gives him a key to her hotel room. Phil finally realizes that Claire understood the situation much better than he did.

Things become even more awkward when Claire finds an old photo and discovers that Phil started dating her before he had officially broken up with Denise. Denise is furious because she always thought Phil had left her long before meeting Claire. She storms out, leaving Phil in trouble with both women.

Meanwhile, Manny is upset because he didn’t get a part in a school play. Jay buys him a motivational poster and hangs it above his pet turtle’s tank. The poster falls and kills the turtle.

Jay doesn’t want Manny to blame him, so he creates an entire story about a raccoon breaking into the house. He even damages the room and leaves muddy footprints to make the story look real. Gloria sees through the lie and tells him to confess.

Jay explains that years ago, he accidentally killed one of Mitchell’s pets and told him the truth. Mitchell never forgot it, so Jay thinks lying may be kinder this time.

During the turtle’s funeral, Manny notices that he left an open bag of chips in his room. He starts blaming himself, thinking the food must have attracted the raccoon. Jay feels terrible, but he still doesn’t admit what really happened.

That night, Jay can’t sleep. When he goes to Manny’s room, Manny is already awake waiting for him. Manny asks him directly if it really was a raccoon. Jay finally admits that he killed Shel by accident and says he lied because their relationship had only recently started getting better, and he was afraid Manny would be angry with him.

Mitchell is also struggling because his job keeps taking him away from Cameron and Lily. He has already missed several important moments, and when his boss calls him into work on a family day, Mitchell finally says no.

His boss tells him that if he leaves, he’s fired. Mitchell walks out feeling proud and free. Once he gets home, however, he starts worrying about money and panics over what he has done. Cameron supports him, and Jay offers to help while he looks for another job, although the “help” turns out to be the same motivational poster.

In the end, telling the truth is uncomfortable, but every lie in this episode only makes things harder.
